notes.title: 2025 SEPTEMBER PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790851/9146cfebea48c8a5b948dfb48a6e57a1bc15112d.jpg"]

Hello, Soulkeepers!



We would like to inform you that the 2025 September update maintenance has been completed as of Sept. 18th at 07:30 (CET).

All premium buffs, items, pets, and mounts have been extended up to 3 hours.

Maint. Coupon: 1ld2u7iKqVKq (Valid till Sept. 30th)

Thanks for your patience and understanding!

Please click HERE for the full patch notes.

See you in Friggard!
